title: Pre-idea prior-work gate
description: Hardens the literature-research idea phase so candidate ideas cannot be recommended before targeted prior-work checks, overlap classification, existing-defect analysis, improvement-space identification, and a non-duplication rationale.
changes: Add IdeaCard fields for status, targeted_checks_run, overlapping_work, overlap_class, existing_defects, improvement_space, why_not_duplicate, and confidence.
Require targeted existence checks before an idea is presented as a recommendation.
Separate direct duplicates from partial overlap and improvable baselines.
Keep incomplete ideas as draft_unverified instead of presenting them as ranked recommendations.

rollback.notes: Restore the search-diagnostic literature workflow without hard pre-idea prior-work gating.
